t: 约翰·塞巴斯蒂安·巴赫出任莱比锡圣托马斯教堂乐长（Thomaskantor），并于三一节后的第…
te: Johann Sebastian Bach assumes the office of Thomaskantor in Leipzig, presenting his first new cantata, Die Elenden soll…
dz: 约翰·塞巴斯蒂安·巴赫出任莱比锡圣托马斯教堂乐长（Thomaskantor），并于三一节后的第一个星期日在圣尼古拉教堂演出其首部新康塔塔《Die Elenden sollen essen》（BWV 75）。
de: Johann Sebastian Bach assumes the office of Thomaskantor in Leipzig, presenting his first new cantata, Die Elenden sollen essen, BWV 75, in the St. Nicholas Church on the first Sunday after Trinity.

t: 在被大炮包围和轰炸后,巴库向俄国人投降.
te: After a siege and bombardment by cannon, Baku surrenders to the Russians.
dz: 在被大炮包围和轰炸后,巴库向俄国人投降.
de: After a siege and bombardment by cannon, Baku surrenders to the Russians.

t: 约翰·塞巴斯蒂安 巴赫在"三一"后的第8个星期天在莱比锡领衔主演了自己的"Cantata Er…
te: Johann Sebastian Bach leads the first performance of his cantata Erforsche mich, Gott, und erfahre mein Herz, BWV 136, …
dz: 约翰·塞巴斯蒂安 巴赫在"三一"后的第8个星期天在莱比锡领衔主演了自己的"Cantata Erforsche mich"(英语:Cantata Erfersche mich, Gott, und erfahre mein Herz, BWV 136).
de: Johann Sebastian Bach leads the first performance of his cantata Erforsche mich, Gott, und erfahre mein Herz, BWV 136, in Leipzig on the eighth Sunday after Trinity.

t: 伊奥安·久尔吉乌·帕塔奇出任法高拉ș主教,经教宗克莱门特十一世早前正式确认后,在法高拉ș圣尼古…
te: Ioan Giurgiu Patachi becomes Bishop of Făgăraș and is festively installed in his position at the St. Nicolas Cathedral …
dz: 伊奥安·久尔吉乌·帕塔奇出任法高拉ș主教,经教宗克莱门特十一世早前正式确认后,在法高拉ș圣尼古拉大教堂的位置上安放节庆.
de: Ioan Giurgiu Patachi becomes Bishop of Făgăraș and is festively installed in his position at the St. Nicolas Cathedral in Făgăraș, after being formally confirmed earlier by Pope Clement XI.

t: 伊朗和俄罗斯签署"圣彼得堡条约". 伊朗被迫割让里海西岸和南岸的所有土地,而俄罗斯则承诺对奥斯…
te: Iran and Russia sign the treaty of Saint Petersburg. Iran is forced to cede all lands on the western and southern coast…
dz: 伊朗和俄罗斯签署"圣彼得堡条约". 伊朗被迫割让里海西岸和南岸的所有土地,而俄罗斯则承诺对奥斯曼帝国提供军事支援.
de: Iran and Russia sign the treaty of Saint Petersburg. Iran is forced to cede all lands on the western and southern coast of the Caspian Sea and Russia pledges to provide military support against the Ottoman Empire.

t: 外公安东尼奥·马诺埃尔·德·维勒赫纳(António Manoel de Vilhena)为马…
te: Grand Master António Manoel de Vilhena lays down the first stone of Fort Manoel in Malta.
dz: 外公安东尼奥·马诺埃尔·德·维勒赫纳(António Manoel de Vilhena)为马耳他的马诺埃尔堡铺设了第一块石碑.
de: Grand Master António Manoel de Vilhena lays down the first stone of Fort Manoel in Malta.

t: 圣彼得堡条约签订后,帝国俄国获得德本特,巴库,以及吉兰省,马赞达兰省和阿斯特拉巴德省之间的沿海…
te: The treaty of Saint Petersburg is signed, in which Imperial Russia gains Derbent, Baku, and the coastal areas in betwee…
dz: 圣彼得堡条约签订后,帝国俄国获得德本特,巴库,以及吉兰省,马赞达兰省和阿斯特拉巴德省之间的沿海地区从萨法维德波斯获得,而沙阿则接受俄罗斯士兵进行国内维和.
de: The treaty of Saint Petersburg is signed, in which Imperial Russia gains Derbent, Baku, and the coastal areas in between as well as the provinces of Gilan, Mazandaran, and Astrabad from Safavid Persia while the Shah receives Russian soldiers for domestic peacekeeping.

t: Ewigkeit, du Donnerwort, BWV 60, 约翰·塞巴斯蒂安·巴赫为莱比…
te: O Ewigkeit, du Donnerwort, BWV 60, a dialogue cantata by Johann Sebastian Bach for Leipzig, was first performed.
dz: Ewigkeit, du Donnerwort, BWV 60, 约翰·塞巴斯蒂安·巴赫为莱比锡出演的一首对话相声Cantata被首次出道.
de: O Ewigkeit, du Donnerwort, BWV 60, a dialogue cantata by Johann Sebastian Bach for Leipzig, was first performed.

t: 巴赫出演了由莱比锡编剧的"达祖"(Darzu ist erschienen der Sohn …
te: Bach led the first performance of Darzu ist erschienen der Sohn Gottes, BWV 40, his first Christmas Cantata composed fo…
dz: 巴赫出演了由莱比锡编剧的"达祖"(Darzu ist erschienen der Sohn Gottes, BWV 40)的首出演.
de: Bach led the first performance of Darzu ist erschienen der Sohn Gottes, BWV 40, his first Christmas Cantata composed for Leipzig.
